instruction: Buy a t-shirt for Jeremy from Amazon in their favorite color (see phone text message). Get it delivered to their home with gift wrapping. Given the choices, pick the highest rated one.
notes: Two-app task: phone (lookup Jeremy's contact for phone number + home address, then read Jeremy's text messages for the favorite color) and amazon (search t-shirts filtered by that color sorted by rating, add the single top-rated one to an emptied cart, gift-wrap it with quantity 1, add Jeremy's home address as a new amazon address, pick a payment card, place the order). amazon.clear_cart precedes add_product_to_cart so the order contains exactly one item of quantity 1 (evaluation requires a single order item with gift_wrap_quantity == ordered_quantity). Adding an address is allowed (only updates/deletes of amazon.Address are forbidden), and address_text must match Jeremy's home address, so the home_address string is parsed into add_address's name/street/city/state/country/zip fields. Static init facts (phone-of, home-address-of, favorite-color-of, highest-rated, address-parts) link placeholder objects to the entities whose values are only learned at runtime via the lookup actions. No answer is required, so supervisor-complete-task takes only task-record parameters (not API arguments) to ground the goal conditions.

plan: (amazon-add-address jeremy-full-name jeremy-street jeremy-city jeremy-state jeremy-country jeremy-zipcode amazon-token jeremy-home-address jeremy)
(amazon-search-products query-t-shirt type-t-shirt jeremy-favorite-color sort-rating-desc jeremy highest-rated-t-shirt)
